categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in energy-saving, environmental protection, and new energy sectors. Its main business segments include energy-saving services (fuel-saving and comprehensive energy-saving retrofit), environmental protection (low nitrogen combustion, industrial waste gas treatment, solid waste management, software and informatization), and new energy (ammonia co-firing, clean heating, photovoltaic, biomass).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include plasma ignition and stable combustion for coal-fired boilers, digital image flame detection, intelligent combustion control, biomass co-firing, ammonia co-firing, and molten salt thermal energy storage. The company employs EPC and EP project delivery models, custom-designing products based on specific boiler conditions, and integrates digital and AI technologies for combustion optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large coal-fired power plants and energy companies, especially those under the State Energy Group. The company serves the coal power industry focusing on energy-saving retrofits, environmental upgrades, and low-carbon transformation. It also targets emerging markets in new energy and energy storage, with some overseas projects in countries like South Africa and Indonesia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly concentrated in China, with significant business in North China, East China, Northwest China, Northeast China, South China, Central China, and Southwest China. The company has minor overseas exposure with projects and sales in countries including South Africa and Indonesia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, providing technical services, equipment manufacturing, and engineering solutions for coal-fired power plants and energy infrastructure. It also invests in energy projects and new energy technologies, positioning itself as a comprehensive energy service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing coal-fired power plant flexibility upgrades, low-carbon transformation through biomass and ammonia co-firing, intelligent combustion, and new energy storage technologies like molten salt storage. The company emphasizes R&D in digital twin technologies, AI-driven combustion optimization, and integrated energy solutions aligned with China's new power system and carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through EPC and EP project contracts, product sales of customized energy-saving and environmental protection equipment, and service fees. The company also earns investment income from equity stakes in renewable energy projects and government subsidies related to technology development and environmental initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic and internationally recognized service provider in coal power energy-saving and environmental protection retrofit. It holds a strong market position supported by proprietary technologies and strategic partnerships with major state-owned energy groups. Competitors include other specialized energy technology and engineering firms in the coal power and environmental sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 1.28 billion RMB, a 13.06% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about 65.3 million RMB, a decline of 53.77%. The company has total assets around 2.75 billion RMB and maintains a stable growth trajectory despite profit fluctuations due to strategic investments and market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced, proprietary combustion and energy storage technologies, comprehensive lifecycle services for coal-fired power plants, and integration of digital and AI technologies for intelligent energy management. Its pioneering molten salt thermal storage and ammonia co-firing technologies provide unique solutions for flexible, low-carbon power generation, supporting clients' transition to cleaner energy systems.
